description: Configuration schema for defining a new vertical. Use as template.

vertical_template.name: string: human-readable name
vertical_template.description: string: what this vertical is (e.g., 'Online therapy, counseling, coaching')
vertical_template.category: string: B2C | B2B | Creator | SaaS | Marketplace | Other

benchmarks_analyzed.patterns_extracted: array: pattern IDs or brief descriptions

hero.emotional_ratio: number: typical warmth level for this vertical
hero.cta_segmentation: string: how do winners segment users

tone.notes: string: why this tone balance works

visual.density: number 0-10: how densely packed is the layout
visual.colors: array: [color1, color2, ...] that work for this vertical
visual.avoid_colors: array: colors that underperform for this vertical

early_stage.definition: string: MVP or concept, may lack assets

checks.blocking: boolean: can this FAIL or just WARN
checks.message: string: what to tell the user

mid_stage.definition: string: beta or soft launch, some assets exist

missing_asset_handling.logos: string: when to mark MISSING vs FAIL
missing_asset_handling.metrics: string: when to mark MISSING vs FAIL
missing_asset_handling.testimonials: string: when to mark MISSING vs FAIL
missing_asset_handling.credentialing: string: when to mark MISSING vs FAIL
missing_asset_handling.notes: string: general guidance on missing assets vs bad design

core_trust_signals.description: array: what MUST exist by late_stage (non-negotiable)
core_trust_signals.examples: for therapy: credentialing or insurance coverage; for B2B: ROI or compliance

anti_patterns.high_risk: array: patterns that kill conversion for this vertical
anti_patterns.medium_risk: array: patterns that hurt but don't block

reference_sites.description: array: URLs analyzed to build this vertical's config
